subject: Loading Reactive Values From a Previous Session

messages.author: 10c8cda73c65d9b2
messages.subject: Loading Reactive Values From a Previous Session
parts:
I am working on an application that has numerous user inputs, so I am trying to build a function that can successfully load and update all the user inputs with values from the previous session.

So far I have this function to save my input values into an .rdata file:
    output$saveData <- downloadHandler(
        filename = function() {paste(input$workspace,'.RData',sep="")},
        content = function(file) {
            save(input, file=file)
        }
    )


On a new session (i.e. - closing out of the browser and rerunning shinyapp), I have this code for "load settings":

ui.R
fileInput('loadfile', 'Load Settings', accept=c('.RData'))

server.R
    loadSettings <- observe({
        inFile <- input$loadfile
        if (is.null(inFile)) return(NULL)
        load(input$loadfile$datapath)
        updateNumericInput(session, 'myvar1', input$myvar1)
    })

My questions are:
A) Is there a way to load all of the input values automatically, or do I have to write code to manually update all of my input variables?
B) Why is my updateNumericInput call not working to update the Numeric Input for myvar1 on the client side nor update the value outside of the function call?

messages.author: 129e07bdb789652f
messages.subject: Re: Loading Reactive Values From a Previous Session
parts:
B) Your updateNumericInput works but it sets a new value equal to the current value. No ? 

I would save input with another name, and convert it to a list before saving it by using reactiveValuesToList().
